tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch3:3-24Prove that for all positive integers $r$ and $s$ every real number $R > 0$, both the pseudohyperbolic space $\mathbb {H}^{r,s}(R)$ and the pseudosphere $S^{r,s}(R)$ are diffeomorphic to $\mathbb {R}^r \times S^s$. [Hint: Consider the maps $\varphi , \psi : \mathbb {R}^r \times S^s \to \mathbb {R}^{r+s+1}$ given by \[ \varphi (x,y) = \left(Rx, \left(\sqrt{1 + |x|^2}\right) Ry\right), \quad \psi (x,y) = \left(\left(\sqrt{1 + |x|^2}\right) Ry, Rx\right). \] ] \end{exercise}
